text: Implemented JVM-only modules/linalg-breeze adapter. BreezeSolvers exposes symmetric eigen, dense SVD, generalized eigen, SPD inverse, Cholesky lower factor, and full-rank least-squares adapters over linalg DoubleMatrix/DoubleVector contracts; Breeze types remain confined to linalg-breeze. Removed stale hrfJVM Breeze dependency. Verified with linalgBreezeJVM/test and hrfJVM/test.
